section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through the great shofar blast to awaken the lost in Assyria and the dispersed in Egypt, an elevation is also brought about in those lands themselves.
section.t: And it can be said,

that through the blast of the great shofar in order to awaken the lost ones in the land of Assyria and the dispersed ones in the land of Egypt, an elevation is also brought about in the land of Assyria and the land of Egypt.
For the intention in this—that Israel were exiled to the land of Assyria and the land of Egypt,
to the extent that through this they became lost and dispersed—
is,
in order that through the straits of exile,
and particularly the straits of exile of those who, through the exile, became in a state of being lost and dispersed,
the great shofar will be aroused and drawn down,
so that through it Israel will be elevated to a level higher than the level they were on before they went into exile.
Therefore,
when the great shofar is sounded and the intention for which the land of Assyria and the land of Egypt were created is completed,
there will also be an elevation in them.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The connection of the great shofar to Rosh Hashanah is explained through its two aspects: the drawing down of Atzmus Ein Sof through man's service, and the subsequent elevation of all creation.
section.t: And based on this, we can add another matter regarding the connection of "the great shofar shall be sounded" to Rosh Hashanah,
for Rosh Hashanah has two aspects.
It is the day of the creation of man,
and through this an elevation is also brought about in all of creation
(as will be explained below).
And the matter is as explained by the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory, in the maamar beginning "Zeh Hayom Techas Ma'asecha, Zikaron Leyom Rishon"47,
that it is necessary to understand,
behold Rosh Hashanah
("this day")
is on the first of Tishrei, which is the sixth day of the act of creation,
and how is it a remembrance of the first day?
And he explains48,
that the desire for the creation of the world is the externality of the will,
and the innerness of the will is Israel.
And these two matters in the times of the year are on the 25th of Elul and on Rosh Hashanah.
For on the 25th of Elul, when the world was created, it is the externality of the will,
and on Rosh Hashanah
(the first of Tishrei)
when man was created,
"you are called man"49,
it is the innerness of the will.
And this is "This day is the beginning of Your works, a remembrance of the first day,"
for on Rosh Hashanah there are two aspects50.
The primary aspect of Rosh Hashanah is that it is the beginning of Your works,
the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof
(which is above the desire for worlds)
through the service of man,
and there is another aspect on Rosh Hashanah, that it is a remembrance of the first day,
that the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof is also drawn into the desire for the creation of the worlds,
and through this into the worlds51.
And based on this,
the connection of "the great shofar shall be sounded" to Rosh Hashanah is in its two aspects,
the drawing down of the revelation of the great shofar to Israel is related to "the beginning of Your works,"
and the elevation that will come about through it in the land of Assyria and the land of Egypt is related to "a remembrance of the first day."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Even when the arousal for the great shofar comes from a state of self-nullification and feeling like a pauper, it is still called "it will be sounded" of itself, as if without any arousal from below.
section.t: And now, based on what was brought above
(section 5)
from the discourse of the Rebbe Maharash, that the "strait" of the shofar is the matter of "year whose beginning is straitened,"
that the matter of "its beginning is straitened" is that Israel make themselves poor on Rosh Hashanah,
it is understood,
that the matter of the strait through which the expanse is drawn is also when the strait is from the aspect of self-nullification,
that his service is complete, but because of his self-nullification he feels that he is in a strait,
even through this strait the expanse is drawn.
And likewise regarding the revelation of the great shofar that is aroused and drawn through the strait of the lost and dispersed,
that even when his service is complete, but he contemplates that relative to the loftiness of Ein Sof even true service is considered a sin52,
and therefore he feels himself to be lost and dispersed,
through this the revelation of the great shofar is aroused and drawn.
And it can be said that even then
(when the drawing down of the revelation of the great shofar is through his self-nullification)
the expression "yitaka" applies
(with a kamatz under the tav),
"it will be sounded" of itself,
for when he makes himself a poor and needy person,
the matter of the poor person is that he has nothing of his own and only receives what is given to him in the manner of charity,
he recognizes and feels that this revelation drawn through his service is not because of his own elevation
(that he has the power to draw it down),
but rather from the kindness of the Holy One, blessed be He53,
"it will be sounded" of itself,
as if the drawing down is without any arousal from below at all.
